main_body: altar block draped in white and purple cloth with crosses, sitting on a stepped stone dais
top_band: white altar top with lavender runner and yellow cross (rows 11-23), bordered by a yellow/brown front edge (rows 24-25)
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 10 is back outline; rows 11-23 form the horizontal top surface of the altar (white cloth with a light-purple runner and upright cross); row 24 is a bright gold front-edge trim; row 25 is a dark gold/brown underside shadow; rows 26-36 are the vertical south face in darker purple with a front cross; rows 37-46 are the stepped stone base.

style.evidence: Large flat fills of unshaded pure white (rows 11-23 left/right), flat lavender (rows 12-23 center), and flat purple bands with zero cloth grain or surface texture, contrasting sharply with the textured wood, roof tiles, and stone of the Beodeul references.
